_evidence: The HUD/LCD text file 'ldata\<language>.3d' that 0x54ca5e reads (CreateFileA, size check 'cmp eax,0x2000; ja fail', ReadFile into 0x891ce0) and parses in place through 0x5146e0 -> 0x51488e. 0x51488e: esi = edi = 0x891ce0, ebx = the name table 0x891724 (constant .data: the 0x44 names JACKED_UP_TYRE_CHOICE_TEXT: .. SKYMESS_NETWORK_WAITING:), 0x44 entries (ecx). Per entry: 0x5146e8 skips blanks (space/tab); ';' or CR (not followed by LF) -> 0x5146f2 skips to the LF; CR LF -> next line; otherwise 0x5146f8 reads the name up to ':' (it compares each char with [ebx] and steps ebx, but both outcomes of 'cmp al,ah; je 0x514700' reach 0x514700, so the name is not checked; 9 chars per entry at most keep ebx inside the table), [0x891bd0+4*k] = edi, then 0x5147aa value lines (text_005147aa grammar: ',' blanks, ';'/CR end the line, '".."' strings copied, '+'/'-'/digits numbers - every byte up to ',' CR LF space TAB counts as a digit - stored as bytes, 'DB '/'db<TAB>' skipped, any other byte opens a string up to the next '"', 'D'/'d' not followed by B/b + blank re-reads forever) are parsed until the output is non-empty ('cmp edi,[..]; je') and ends in 0xff ('cmp byte [edi-1],0xff; jne'); then 0x514705 per line: 'DB '/'db<TAB>' -> 0x514877 record ('h' -> 0x514848: keyword from the 0x89167c list - the empty end entry would match anything as index 7 and store through the text 'JACK' at [0x891724], so only the seven keywords are valid - then 4 numbers into the constant destination [0x891708+4k]; anything else -> 0x514821: index of the 0x8915ac 'lcdp_' keyword list (10 = none; a match also consumes the char after the keyword) stored at edi, then 6 numbers, each 'skip blanks and commas, parse a number'), CR/';' -> skip the line, any other char ends the entry (0xff stored) and starts the next one. So the original only terminates on a text whose every value line ends its number with a terminator and whose entries close with a 0xff byte; the file is runtime data (zero in the image: 8/8 cases ran off the buffer). The text here is a sequence of 4-byte slots (u32 fields) that are each a complete token for the parser state at that position, generated by the L58 script gen_text2.py: per entry [pre: blanks, comment line, CR LF, CR CR LF] [name: 4 chars without ':' + a ':' slot with only blanks after it] [values: a first slot that may also be an empty or comment-only line (the je arm), two middle slots - numbers incl. 255 and signed, strings incl. 0xff/';'/CR bytes and a 0x80 byte opening a string closed by '"', 'DB '/'db<TAB>' directives, commas, blanks, and line ends that first store a non-0xff number (7/9, so the 0xff test repeats 0x5147aa on the next line) - then a slot storing 0xff last (-1, 255, '"<ff>"') and a line-end slot] [an 'l' record line: 'DB l'/'db<TAB>l'/'Db l'/'dB l' or ';;;;' (the whole line skipped) + the fixed rest of 'l' keyword j + ',' + 5 middle and 1 last number slots (the last without a trailing comma: a comma there would end the entry) + an end slot] and for j < 7 an 'h' record line ('DB h'/'db<TAB>h'/'dB h' or ';;;;' + the fixed rest of 'h' keyword j + ',' + 3+1 numbers + end). Ten entries form a 0x480-byte superblock (entry j: 'l' keyword j, 'h' keyword j for j < 7) repeated with stride 0x480: 6 full copies plus entries 0..7 = 0x44 entries, 0x1ed0 bytes < 0x2000; the byte after the text is zero (unlisted bss), which ends the last entry. Output is written in place behind the read pointer (every token consumes at least as many bytes as it stores). Also varied: the 'h' destinations read after the loop - [0x894126] (copied to 0x894164/0x8941a2/0x8941d8/0x89420a) and the bytes [0x894238]/[0x894239] (0x51493c clamps both: any byte is valid) - which the text's hlight_TYRE/hlight_PREFERENCES records overwrite unless skipped, and the gate bytes [0x7a8e0e] / [0x7a97a3] ('cmp ..,0; je/jne' around 'call 0x51493c', set by 0x54bd37 / 0x52f830 and only tested for zero) drawn 0 / 1 / 0xff. Values are synthetic (no bytes of the game's file are copied). The 22-byte flag table 0x7c2a48 that 0x51493c updates ('or byte [eax+0x7c2a48],0x80' with eax = clamp([0x894238],1,0x16)-1) is varied too (any byte). Constant tables keep their image values: the keyword lists 0x8915ac/0x89167c, the destination table 0x891708 and the name table 0x891724.
